release_notes:
SOC Chat App v1.0.22 - FCM Notifications & Data Migration:
- Fixed FCM token registration - tokens now automatically register on login
- Improved FCM service initialization with retry logic
- Added Firebase initialization for FCM push notifications
- Moved all app data to D drive (MongoDB, uploads)
- Enhanced FCM token management with automatic retry
- Better error handling for FCM token registration
- All data now stored on D:\soc-chat-data partition
- FCM notifications ready for all platforms (Android, iOS, Web)
